text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold positions after gains, which felt satisfying, but I should not let that feeling alone determine when to exit.","Selling winners while buying stocks at higher prices can undermine returns; I should consider the whole portfolio rather than each position's gain or loss since purchase.","Past price changes do not predict future moves, so I should avoid chasing recent rises or treating dips as bargains and instead make decisions based on risk and diversification."]}
